intro: Set phrases for answering, asking for someone and leaving a message.
p.diga.consejo: It is the command of «decir». In Spain you answer with «¿diga?». The g is hard.
p.de parte de quién.consejo: It is the polite way to ask the name of the caller.
p.un momento.consejo: It asks for a short wait. It is also used in shops and offices.
p.ahora se pone.glosa: he/she will be on in a moment
p.ahora se pone.consejo: Here «se pone» means that the person comes to the phone.
p.no está.consejo: With «estar» you say if someone is or is not in a place: «no está en casa».
p.recado.consejo: You say «dejar un recado». It is a short message, spoken or written.
p.más tarde.consejo: It is used a lot: «te llamo más tarde». The opposite is «más temprano».
p.se ha equivocado.consejo: It is «equivocarse» in the present perfect. The qu and v sound k and b.
p.está comunicando.consejo: You hear it when the person is already talking to someone else: from «comunicar».
p.colgar.consejo: It is irregular: «cuelgo», «cuelgas». Phones used to be literally hung up.
p.llamada.consejo: It is the noun of «llamar»: «una llamada». The ll sounds y.
b1.texto:
To answer, in Spain you say **¿Diga?**, **¿Dígame?** or **¿Sí?**

To ask for someone: **¿Está Ana?** or **¿Puedo hablar con Ana?** More formal: **¿Me puede poner con el señor Ruiz?**

The person answering may say: **Un momento, ahora se pone.** Or ask: **¿De parte de quién?** To introduce yourself use **ser**: **Soy Pablo.** Or: **Soy yo.**

If the person is out: **No está. ¿Quiere dejar un recado?** You can say: **La llamo más tarde.**

If someone dials the wrong number: **Se ha equivocado.** If the line is busy: **Está comunicando.**
b2.f3.texto: I am Pablo, a friend from university.
b2.f5.texto: Do you want to leave a message?
b2.f7.texto: Thank you for your call, Pablo.
b4.titulo: Ser to introduce yourself, estar for the place
b4.texto:
Three key verbs are used on the phone:

- **ser** to say who you are: **Soy** Pablo. **Soy yo.**
- **estar** to ask if someone is at home: **¿Está** Lucía? **No está.**
- **llamar** with **lo / la** to talk about who you call: **La llamo** más tarde (Lucía). **Lo llamo** más tarde (Pablo).

Do not say **Estoy Pablo**: for your name you always use **soy**.

Polite phrases: **un momento**, **por favor**, **gracias por su llamada**. To finish, **colgar**: **no cuelgue**, por favor.
b5.f0.texto: The phone suddenly rings in the dark living room.
b5.f1.texto: A green glow lights up the wooden table.
b5.f2.texto: Pablo puts down the book and gets up from the sofa.
b5.f3.texto: His short steps cross the narrow corridor.
b5.f4.texto: A distant voice says his name among background noises.
b5.f5.texto: On the other end of the line there is a clear laugh.
b5.f6.texto: Lucía tells about her day with quick, cheerful words.
b5.f7.texto: Pablo listens with the receiver next to his ear.
b5.f8.texto: The moon peeks through the window like a white coin.
b5.f9.texto: Pablo smiles in the half-light of the room as he hangs up.
b6.o0.refuerzo: That's it! It is the usual, polite way.
b6.o1.refuerzo: It sounds rude. Better to start with «¿diga?».
b6.o2.refuerzo: «Adiós» is for ending, not for starting.
b6.pregunta: You answer the phone in Spain. What do you say?
b7.o0.refuerzo: Well done: «de parte de quién» is the fixed formula.
b7.o1.refuerzo: «De lado de» does not exist in this phrase.
b7.o2.refuerzo: «De llamada de quién» is not said.
b8.traduccion: Do you want to leave a message
b9.o0.refuerzo: Yes! For your name you always use «soy».
b9.o1.refuerzo: «Estoy» is not used with a name.
b9.o2.refuerzo: «Tengo» means to have, not to introduce yourself.
b9.pregunta: How do you say «It's Pablo» on the phone?
b11.frase: Ana no está. ____ llamo más tarde.
b11.o0.refuerzo: Well done! «La» replaces a woman: Ana.
b11.o1.refuerzo: «Lo» is for a man; Ana is a woman.
b11.o2.refuerzo: «Le» is of another type: here «llamar» takes «la».
b12.o0.refuerzo: You say that when they ask for you.
b12.o1.refuerzo: Exactly! You politely tell them about their mistake.
b12.o2.refuerzo: That asks to wait; there is nobody to fetch here.
b12.pregunta: What do you say if someone dialled the wrong number?
p.cuelgue.consejo: From «colgar», to hang. Here the gue sounds like «ge».
p.resplandor.consejo: Starts with rr, strong. The stress is on DOR.
p.rápidas.consejo: Feminine plural of «rápido». The stress is on RA.
p.auricular.consejo: The stress is on the last syllable, LAR.
p.asoma.consejo: From «asomar», to appear or peek out.
